question.prompt: In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle C=90^\circ\), \(AC=6\), and \(BC=8\). Find the length of the median \(CD\) to the hypotenuse \(AB\).

solutions.explanation: By the Pythagorean theorem, \(AB=10\). The median to the hypotenuse has length \(CD=AB\div2=5\).
solutions.title: Find the hypotenuse first
